tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Validate a single email address in real time using NoBounce API. Checks RFC 5322 syntax, DNS MX records, 5,000+ disposable providers, role accounts, free webmail providers, typo suggestions, and optional SMTP handshake.

tools.name: validate_emails_bulk
tools.description: Validate a batch of up to 1,000 email addresses in a single call using NoBounce API. Returns per-email validation results plus summary counts (valid, invalid, disposable, catch_all, unknown).

tools.name: find_email
tools.description: Find and verify a person's B2B work email address given their name (first_name + last_name or full_name) and company domain. Generates corporate email permutations and verifies them via MX, Microsoft 365, Gravatar, and live SMTP handshake. Uses your shared NoBounce credit pool (0 credits charged if

tools.name: get_domain_intelligence
tools.description: Inspect a company domain's email infrastructure: MX records, email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho Mail, Proofpoint, Mimecast, etc.), SPF/DMARC security policies, disposable/free flags, catch-all status, and overall deliverability grade.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_domain_intelligence · Private data: validate_email, get_domain_intelligence · Public sink: validate_email, validate_emails_bulk, find_email, get_domain_intelligence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_domain_intelligence · Private data: validate_email, get_domain_intelligence · Public sink: validate_email, validate_emails_bulk, find_email, get_domain_intelligence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
